name: Contribución única y temporal (Ley de Simplificación y Progresividad Tributaria, Dec 2019)
detail: Levy of 0.10% to 0.20% on the 2018 income of companies with revenue of USD 1 million or more: an income-based corporate levy.

name: Ley de Apoyo Humanitario contributions (2020)
detail: Contributions on salaries and on company profits to pay for the pandemic; not a tax on net wealth.

name: Ley de herencias (Correa, 2015)
detail: Progressive inheritance and gift tax proposal, withdrawn after protests: an inheritance tax.

name: Cedocut
detail: Asked for the collection of the large companies' tax debts instead of the VAT rise; not a wealth tax.

name: Pachakutik
detail: Opposed the 2024 VAT rise and the forgiveness of debts of large groups; no wealth-tax position found.

name: FUT proposals of July 2024
detail: One-time 5% special contribution on the extraordinary profits of the 100 largest companies, and collection of tax debts: profits and arrears, not net wealth.

name: Kintto Lucas
detail: Uruguayan writer (Wikidata nationality Uruguay) who wrote in 2015 that taxes on large fortunes should be added to the inheritance tax; belongs in the Uruguay register, not this one.
